routes.label: Previous tosses do not change the next toss

answerCheck.reason: For independent fair tosses, heads frequency tends to stabilize near 0.5. Previous tails do not raise the next heads probability, and finite runs need not have exact predicted counts.
Probability 1/2 does not force five heads in ten tosses. For example, ten tails has positive probability (1/2)^10.

routes.label: Distinguish probability from a guaranteed count

answerCheck.derivedAnswer: C, understood as a statement of long-run statistical tendency.
